subject: Maths
title: Fractions of amounts
subtitle: Fractions — All Operations · KS3 Maths
learning_objective: I can find a fraction of a given amount by dividing and multiplying.

key_vocab.term: Finding a fraction of an amount
key_vocab.definition: To find a fraction of an amount, divide the amount by the denominator then multiply by the numerator.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can find a fraction of a given amount by dividing and multiplying.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: Finding a fraction of an amount -- To find a fraction of an amount, divide the amount by the denominator then multiply by the numerator.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Divide by the denominator first to find one part, then multiply by the numerator to find the required number of parts.
&frac{a}{b} of n = n ÷ b × a
Divide by bottom, multiply by top

Key examples:
  ✓ &frac{1}{4} of 60 = 15  (60 ÷ 4 = 15)
  ✓ &frac{2}{5} of 30 = 12  (30 ÷ 5 = 6, then 6 × 2)
  ✓ &frac{3}{4} of 80 = 60  (80 ÷ 4 = 20, then 20 × 3)
  ✗ &frac{2}{5} of 30 = 6  (forgot to multiply by numerator)
  ✗ &frac{3}{4} of 80 = 240  (multiplied by both 3 and 4)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – unit fraction
  Find &frac{1}{5} of 45
  Divide by the denominator: 45 ÷ 5
  = 9
  &frac{1}{5} of 45 = 9
  = 9
  (For unit fractions, just divide by the denominator.)

Example 2 – non-unit fraction
  Find &frac{3}{4} of 60
  Divide by 4: 60 ÷ 4 = 15
  Multiply by 3: 15 × 3 = 45
  &frac{3}{4} of 60 = 45
  = 45
  (Divide by the bottom number, multiply by the top number.)

sections.title: Unit fractions of amounts
sections.content:
Find each fraction of the amount.

(a) &frac{1}{3} of 27
(b) &frac{1}{4} of 48
(c) &frac{1}{6} of 42
(d) &frac{1}{8} of 56

sections.title: Non-unit fractions
sections.content:
Find the fraction of each amount.

(a) &frac{2}{5} of 35
(b) &frac{3}{4} of 44
(c) &frac{4}{7} of 49
(d) &frac{5}{8} of 72

sections.title: Fractions of money
sections.content:
Find the fraction of each amount.

(a) &frac{3}{5} of £40
(b) &frac{2}{3} of £63
(c) &frac{5}{6} of £54
(d) &frac{7}{10} of £120

sections.title: Finding the whole amount
sections.content:
Work backwards to find the original amount.

(a) &frac{1}{4} of a number = 9. Find the number.
(b) &frac{2}{5} of a number = 18. Find the number.
(c) &frac{3}{7} of a number = 21. Find the number.
(d) &frac{5}{8} of a number = 30. Find the number.

sections.title: Mixed problems
sections.content:
Solve each problem.

(a) &frac{3}{10} of 80
(b) &frac{4}{9} of 63
(c) &frac{2}{3} of £99
(d) &frac{5}{6} of a number = 35. Find it.
(e) &frac{7}{8} of 64

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ &frac{2}{5} of 30 means 30 ÷ 5 × 2 = 12
✗ &frac{2}{5} of 30 means 30 ÷ 5 = 6
✓ &frac{3}{4} of 80 = 60
✗ Finding a fraction of an amount always gives a smaller number
✓ To find the whole, divide by numerator then multiply by denominator
